question: Which of the following is NOT an internal part of the computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flash drive**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A flash drive, also known as a USB drive or thumb drive, is an external storage device that connects to a computer via a USB port.
 
• It is not an integral internal component of a computer but is used for portable data storage and transfer.
 
• Flash drives are commonly used to store and transfer files between computers and other devices.
 
• Unlike internal components like RAM, video card, and motherboard, a flash drive is not necessary for the computer's internal operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **RAM (Random Access Memory)**

 
 
• RAM is a type of computer memory that can be accessed randomly.
 
 
• **Video Card**
 
 
• A video card, also known as a graphics card, is an internal component responsible for rendering images and videos on the computer's display.
 
• It has its own processor, called a GPU (Graphics Processing Unit), and memory to handle graphics-intensive tasks.
 
• High-performance video cards are essential for gaming, video editing, and other graphics-intensive applications.
 
• It is installed on the motherboard and connects to the display through various ports like HDMI, DisplayPort, or DVI.
 
 
 
• **Motherboard**
 
 
• The motherboard is the main circuit board of a computer.
 
 
• **Flash Drive**
 
 
• A flash drive is a portable storage device that uses flash memory.
 
• It connects to a computer's USB port and is used for data transfer and storage.
 
• Flash drives come in various storage capacities, ranging from a few gigabytes to several terabytes.
 
• They are commonly used to store documents, photos, videos, and other files.
